_doc: Injury scarring (ROADMAP §3.5: 'untreated injuries can scar into permanent trait tradeoffs'). A battle injury opens an Infirmary timer; pay to treat it and it clears clean, ignore it and there is a chance it sets badly and stays. EVERY SCAR IS TWO-SIDED, which is the whole design: a scar is character, not a punishment, so missing a treatment window is interesting rather than ruinous — and some scars are net GOOD for a given build, which makes 'leave it and see' a real choice rather than a mistake. `vs` narrows an effect to opponents carrying one of those tags, which is what makes the roadmap's own example ('Chompers now fears jeeps: +Evasion vs. vehicles, −Accuracy vs. vehicles') expressible as data. Effects: acc is percentage points on the move roll; evasion is a fraction off the attacker's chance to connect; power and armor are fractions of damage dealt and taken; speed and regen are flat additions to the stat. Adding a scar is one object here and nothing else.

scars.name: Jeep Shyness
scars.line: {name} has developed strong opinions about anything with an engine, and gives it a wide, twitchy berth.

scars.name: Grudge Against Uniforms
scars.line: {name} has learned what a clipboard means and no longer waits to find out which kind.

scars.name: Kazoo Tinnitus
scars.line: There is a ringing. {name} cannot locate the ringing. {name} has stopped trusting the middle distance.

scars.name: Sky Wariness
scars.line: {name} now checks upward first, every time, before doing literally anything else.

scars.name: Reinforced Limp
scars.line: It set crooked and it set STRONG. {name} moves like weather and arrives like furniture.

scars.name: Wound Memory
scars.line: {name} remembers exactly how that felt and has decided to be the one doing it from now on.

scars.name: Salt-Water Grudge
scars.line: Something wet was involved. {name} has not forgiven the sea, or anything that reminds it of the sea.

scars.name: Overcompensating Jaw
scars.line: {name} bites harder now. {name} also misses more, because {name} bites harder now.

scars.name: Chipped Plating
scars.line: Lighter, in the way that losing pieces of yourself is technically lighter. {name} is noticeably quicker about it.

scars.name: Learned Flinch
scars.line: {name} has acquired a flinch. It is a very good flinch. It is not a helpful flinch when attacking.
